text_block_list.text: Tomorrow, our summer camp begins.

This training camp away from home is a
perfect chance for runners to
focus and
hone their abilities. However...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A training camp by the beach... This'll be
niiice.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Taking in the marine breeze as I fish in
the
sea... Drifting to sleep in
the sun with
waves as my lullaby...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mm-hm, we're gonna have so much fun! ♪

I rack my brain thinking of ways to get
Sky
to actually train during this
summer camp...

And by the time I come up with a plan, the
sun is already shining
through my window.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oooh, blue skies and blue seas!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's the perfect weather for fishing! We've gotta go surf fishing tod—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh... Do we really have to train?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fine, fine,
have it your way... Hm? Wait, is
this a special program?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's see here...
"Use these hints to dig up
buried treasure around the
beach..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"If you can find all the treasure within
the time limit, then you will be
rewarded with
all-you-can-eat meals at the beachside
clubhouse for the rest of the camp..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I get it! You're trying to rouse my
adventurous spirit while also testing
how
fast I can run!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This training program combines both fun
and exercise—it's hard to
argue with that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okay then, you've piqued my curiosity! I
accept—let's do this training!

Sky agrees enthusiastically to my
proposal,
which means pulling an
all-nighter to plan
this was worth it. Still...

The blazing rays of the sun are a bit
harsh for the sleep-deprived. I
should make sure
I stay hydrated, or I might actually
collapse.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Eeearth to Trainer. You've been spacing
out a bit. Everything okay?

I read off the next hint,
and Sky dashes off
towards the beach once
more. See, she
can do it if she tri—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey now... You okay?!

I lose my balance, falling onto the sandy
beach. The whole world
goes black...

Opening my eyes, I find myself lying on a
couch in the lodge.

Last I remember, I was training on the
beach with Sky...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, it's almost dinnertime,
but Sei still
hasn't come back, right?
Where did she go
this time?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Well, she did say she was going to the
beach for some fishing
earlier...

Looks like Sei is still out by the
water. I
decide to get up and go look
for her.

Outside,
I see a familiar silhouette running
along the shore.
Crunch, crunch...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whew... I'd say I've outdone myself this
time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
But just in case, I'll do two—no,
three more
laps.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoa! Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um... glad you woke up. I don't know
what I'd do if you never got
up again.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, the more you rest,
the more I get to
slack off. So it wasn't the
worst deal for
me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I had a bunch of fun while you were out,
you know.

She says that, but I notice specks of sand
all over her tracksuit.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes of yours see right through me,
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I love slacking off,
but even I
know there's a time and
place for it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... You worked yourself
to the bone planning all
this for me, so I
wanted to make good on it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If I'm not mistaken,
and I rarely ever am...
Did I... just level up again?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Da-dada-da-dada-daaah! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I knew it! Our bond just rose another
level!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I bet you were all like, "Wow! I'm so
proud!" after seeing me train all
by myself,
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't tell me that collapsing was
part of your plan to get me
training of my
own free will?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yikes,
I'm getting chills! You may not look
it, but you're a real crafty
one! Sheesh!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Though if we're talking about being
crafty, then you and I are
partners in
crime.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haha, you think so too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then I guess I'll have to look forward to
seeing more of your future
schemes.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Like, what if we caused a huge upset at
the Twinkle Series? ...Just
kidding!

She says it's a joke... but the fierce
determination welling up in her
eyes tells a
very different story.
